description: Defines the interface for a time alignment estimator class used in OFDM signal processing, including methods for estimating time alignment from frequency domain symbols from single or multiple antenna ports with various input parameters.

classes.name: time_alignment_estimator
classes.description: Interface class for estimating time alignment in OFDM systems, providing multiple overloaded estimate methods for different input types and configurations.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Pure virtual method to estimate time alignment from frequency domain symbols, with variants accepting span or re_buffer_reader, and parameters for mask, subcarrier spacing, stride, and maximum time alignment.
